features.name: vendor_id_scaled
features.description: Unit-scaled vendor_id with clipping to the observed fit-split bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a stable vendor-position signal without raw identifier scale dominating.

features.name: cluster_id_scaled
features.description: Unit-scaled cluster_id with clipping to the observed fit-split bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds coarse catalog-position signal on a stable scale for SVM margins.

features.name: vendor_cluster_log_ratio
features.description: Log-compressed ratio of cluster_id to vendor_id, clipped to a unit interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth nonlinear projection of catalog position relative to vendor position, useful for linear boundaries.

features.name: title_portable_personal_device_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a pocketable personal electronic item; 1 means strong evidence from handset, SIM, unlocked-network, storage-capacity, or similar cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps distinguish compact personal electronics from large household goods through a smooth text-derived cue.

features.name: title_viewing_display_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a large viewing display; 1 means strong evidence from screen size, resolution, HDR, panel, remote, smart-entertainment, or similar cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dense signal for screen-centered entertainment products that a linear model can weight directly.

features.name: title_image_capture_optics_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of still/video capture gear; 1 means strong evidence from lens, optical zoom, megapixel, sensor, kit, or similar imaging cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an interpretable imaging-equipment axis that supports cleaner linear separation from other electronics.

features.name: title_processor_component_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of standalone computing silicon or board-level component; 1 means strong evidence from processor, socket, GHz, cores, cache, Xeon, Core, Ryzen, or similar hardware cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a continuous component-hardware cue for products whose titles are dominated by technical specifications.

features.name: title_food_heating_cavity_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a compact food-heating appliance; 1 means strong evidence from wattage, grill, turntable, cavity litres, defrost, cooking program, or similar cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth kitchen-heating signal that helps a linear model isolate compact cooking appliances.

features.name: title_cold_storage_presence_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of temperature-controlled food storage; 1 means strong evidence from frost-free, under-counter, larder, chest, upright, capacity-litre, or similar cold-storage cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a broad cold-storage axis while leaving subtype detail to a companion profile feature.

features.name: title_cold_storage_temperature_profile
features.description: Signed semantic profile from product_title only: -1 means fresh-chill or larder emphasis, 0 means mixed, paired, ambiguous, or no cold-storage evidence, and 1 means subzero or frozen-goods emphasis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Splits cold-storage rows along fresh-chill versus subzero emphasis while preserving a smooth linear axis.

features.name: title_wet_cleaning_presence_score
features.description: Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a water-using cleaning appliance; 1 means strong evidence from load kg, spin rpm, place settings, cutlery, wash program, integrated fit, or similar wet-cleaning cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a broad wet-cleaning appliance signal that is smooth enough for a linear SVM.

features.name: title_wet_cleaning_load_profile
features.description: Signed semantic profile from product_title only: -1 means tableware or place-setting emphasis, 0 means ambiguous or no wet-cleaning evidence, and 1 means fabric, laundry, spin, or load-weight emphasis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Distinguishes fabric-care wording from tableware-cleaning wording using a single continuous axis.
